MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 9 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 8
   C. 16
   D. 9

2. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 1

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 6x

4. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 156

5. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 37
   C. 31.6
   D. 31

6. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)

   C. 2
   D. 37

7. What is √100? (1 mark)

   B. 50
   C. 11
   D. 10

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 55
   B. 16
   C. 22
   D. 32

9. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 36

10. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

11. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

12. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 21
   C. 15
   D. 15.6

13. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

14. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 13
   C. 1
   D. 7

15. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 32
   C. 33
   D. 4

16. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 7
   C. 14
   D. 49

17. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 81

18. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 41
   C. 49
   D. 31

19. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 30
   C. 75
   D. 20

20. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)

   D. 13

   A. 73

   C. 1
   D. 72

23. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 1

24. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

25. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 10

26. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)

27. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43

   D. 1

28. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122

29. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 25
   C. 19.7
   D. 19

30. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 2
